extension.summary: Shows Cumination's site logos properly in poster views (Bingie and other skins)
extension.description: Cumination's site logos are small wide banners. Skins that fit poster art into a fixed 2:3 frame, such as Bingie's poster views, stretch them out of shape. This service rebuilds each logo as a 2:3 poster: the logo unscaled in the middle, on a card in the logo's own background colour (or a light or dark card for transparent logos), kept inside the central 16:9 band so landscape and square views still show it whole. Originals are backed up and can be restored from the settings, and the posters are re-applied automatically after Cumination updates. JPEG, GIF and WebP logos are left as they are.
